steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Is everybody okay?

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: Y- yeah. The whole building is gone... what in the world was that...?

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: How about you? You just passed straight through the center of an active Art, it's pretty wild in there.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Pfft, I just noticed, why did you cut your hair short?

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Did you just laugh at me?

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Our heads are full of sand. Even short hair needs tender love and care.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: I'm fine. Thank you.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Thank you? It's like we're strangers now.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Or it's like I know basic manners.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Heh. Yeah, I guess that's true.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Maybe if you weren't always sleeping during work, playing rock music outside the church, getting the Notarial Hall to chase you three blocks,

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: until your old school you accidentally blew up unfurls a big banner the day you leave Laterano, 'Good luck in Lungmen, Exusiai!'

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Oh? Are we up to the part of our reunion where we pick away at old scars? Okay, my turn.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: By all means.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: ...Nope. Come to think of it, I don't actually know any dirt on you!

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Good girls shouldn't know too much.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: You playing my big sister now?!

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Yeah, pretty much.

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: (These two seem to get along well. Is it because they're both from Laterano?)

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: (And someone can actually talk over Exusiai...)

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Um... Mostima. I've got a little question I need to ask. A teensy weensy tiny little question.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Yes?

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Why did you come back now?

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Oh, well, lots of reasons. How can I explain it.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: First, for work.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Second, Sauin means lots of sales in Lungmen. Things get pretty exciting.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: ...all those Sauins we had no idea where you were, you decide to come back this year?

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Let's get to what you're really asking.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: *Sigh*... if you know what it is then just tell me already.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Heh. It's nice to see you all twisted up at a loss for words. Brings back memories.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: And it's probably not right to get into all this stuff in front of our guest.

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: Oh... Don't worry about me. I'll hang back here. You two can say what you need to.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: That's no good. There's still a chance we're being followed.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Hey! Don't use Bison as an excuse, you crafty witch!

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: We should meet up with Texas and the girls first. Who knows how many scary mobsters have eyes on us now.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Are you always getting into this much trouble when I'm not around?

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: I wouldn't say always. Maybe four days a week? Four or five? Or six or seven or eight?

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: ...Right. Definitely not always.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: What about you? Where did you go?

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: You know, when I saw the boss back there, he told me you already left Lungmen. You know how that made me feel?

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: All kinds of places. Too many to name.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Down to a tiny village nobody's ever heard of to pick up a letter and then go hiking through a mountain range to chase after a nomadic city. That kind of thing.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Sounds lonely.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: But maybe my travelogue will sell well.

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: Have you been to every country, Mostima?

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Most of them. You jealous?

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: ...a little. Most Messengers don't get to do things like that.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: You'll get a chance. But don't count on Penguin Logistics. We don't really use common sense.

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: Yeah, I'm well aware by now...

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Sitting in a truck in the middle of the endless desert, staring at the setting sun through the yellow sand... It sounds romantic, but when that romance stretches into hundreds of hours, it starts to wear thin.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: I've never seen a yellow sand sunset, but don't you think it's pretty dusty out here today?

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Lungmen's air quality has really dropped in the past few years. They need to add some more air purifiers!

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Air quality...? Maybe.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Exusiai, Bison, I hate to do this, but you two go on...

steps.name: Bison & Exusiai
steps.text: Again?

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Come on. Don't you think I control my entrances and exits very well?

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: ...Are you serious?

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: It's just a few hours for you, but for me...

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Fine, Mostima! But you better buy me dinner! Really!

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: I know. I know.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Whew. What a night.

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: Can we just leave Mostima by herself like that?

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Who's leaving her? Even if we didn't let her go, she would just disappear at some point.

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: ...are you upset?

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Aaaah! Let's go find Texas already! We'll talk about this another time!

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: For Exusiai to go missing at a time like this...

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Um, are we in trouble here?

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: We're surrounded. An ambush right in the slums.

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Are these fellers with them mafia boys? They look different.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: No, I recognize some faces. These are all local Lungmen people.

steps.name: Lungmenite?
steps.text: Dai Lo says to teach them a lesson.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Um? Umm... aren't we looking for Texas?

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: What's going on? Why are these guys surrounding us all of a sudden?

steps.name: Lungmenite?
steps.text: ...isn't it you who busted in here?

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: See! It's just you wandering around without asking for directions!

steps.name: Lungmenite?
steps.text: I'm afraid we can't let you leave.

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: I'm sorry?

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Well, you're a Forte, and you've got a shield...

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: We do it the usual, Me-and-Croissant Style. You clear a path, I'll bring up the rear, but there's no completion bonus this time. Yeehaw!
